assertions: migration fails partway: every update captures a recovery point (data.backup, retry observe_then_replay) after dependencies start and before the runtime switch; a failed activation leaves the prior pointer and the recovery point recorded on the cloud side for the declared restore path (backup.EvaluateRollback restore plan)
a schema-changing update binds the plan to precondition recovery_point_required=<release>@<schema>
limitations: package lane only: the target owner (vrooli cloud-target) is exercised through internal/cloudtarget tests and a stateful fake target in api/vps; QEMU and real-VPS activation subsets are pending EXT-06 (disposable target lane) and EXT-01 (real VPS)

side_by_side is selected only for workloads without persistent data and without pinned manifest ports; the target activator delegates candidate allocation to the lifecycle owner's restart, so a candidate never runs beside the current release yet (recorded limitation)

the transactional semantics of the schema migration itself are the scenario's declared migration owner's; this lane proves the recovery point precedes the change and that the failure leaves the predecessor active
